data.body: **[P1] Do not bypass ownership checks for every exception envelope.** This exemption accepts an `EXCEPTION` envelope from any entity or execution, so swapping another operation's error payload silently defeats the documented ownership boundary. Legitimately forwarded errors are now rebound at child/root boundaries, while chained-invoke errors already have their own exception. Remove this blanket exemption, rebind any remaining forwarding paths, and add a mismatched-owner exception test.
